title: Harden RigSkinningSweepDiagnostic machine-readable output
description: Seven-seat editor/lifecycle review found RigSkinningSweepDiagnostic produced locale-sensitive numeric JSON/CSV via ToString("R") without CultureInfo.InvariantCulture and escaped only quotes/backslashes in JSON strings. A locale using comma decimal separators can make summary JSON invalid, while control characters in rig/mesh names can also corrupt the file. Fix the editor-only diagnostic with invariant numeric formatting and complete JSON string escaping while preserving its existing evidence workflow.

comments.author: council-seven-seat-audit
comments.body: Implemented invariant numeric formatting for JSON/CSV output and full JSON escaping for control characters. Existing diagnostic semantics and cleanup flow remain unchanged. Unity execution of the diagnostic remains required under TSK-0169.
